nodes.description: Mutant beta-tropomyosin binds actin with altered affinity or fails to polymerise head-to-tail along the filament. Some variants (for example p.Lys7del) incorporate poorly into the thin filament; others change the position the tropomyosin strand occupies on actin. This is the shared molecular lesion from which the regulatory and structural consequences branch.

nodes.description: A TPM2 cap myopathy with myasthenic features and a secondary neuromuscular transmission defect responded to anticholinesterase therapy. The specific agent is not named in the abstract, so only the drug class is bound.
